enrichment-abilities.json.name: Moritoi Ancients
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Martial Mastery
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Both options apply only to ADEPTUS CUSTODES models with the Martial Ka'tah ability (this gate is not encoded). The 'unmodified melee Hit of 5+ scores a Critical Hit' option is an opaque grant, as crit-threshold changes have no dedicated encoding. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Gilded Champion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The model can use a datasheet ability that states it can only be used once per battle one additional time, but not in the same phase. Cannot be used on the same Character model more than once per battle.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Swift as the Eagle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your unit; the unit makes a Normal move of up to D6". Vehicle units cannot be selected.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Unleash the Lions
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your Command phase on one Allarus Custodians or Aquilon Custodians unit on the battlefield: the unit is split into separate single-model units, each with a Starting Strength of 1.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Vigil Unending
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used on a Character model that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase; it fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks and is then removed from play.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Avenge the Fallen
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Excludes Anathema Psykana units. If the unit is Below Half-strength, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic instead (escalation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Anathema Blademastery
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Wound re-rolls also apply against Battle-shocked targets (not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Psy-Chaff Volley
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Only Anathema Psykana models improve their AP against the prosecuted unit. While a Psyker or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, its models also subtract 1 from their Hit rolls (not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Purgation Sweep
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If a Torrent weapon targets a Psyker or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead (escalation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Shield of Honour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Targets one Anathema Psykana Infantry unit that was selected as a target and one other friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit (excluding Anathema Psykana) within 6": until the end of the phase, attacks that target the Anathema Psykana unit must instead target the other unit, unless it is not an eligible target.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Inevitable Wrath
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase after an enemy unit has shot, on an unengaged Blade Champion unit that lost a wound to those attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Superior Creation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The bearer is set back up as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, one friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of the bearer is no longer Battle-shocked. The bearer also has a Leadership characteristic of 5+ (not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Castellan's Mark
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: After both players deploy, select up to two Adeptus Custodes units (excluding Anathema Psykana) and redeploy them; any of them can be placed into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Huntress' Eye
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Radiant Mantle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only while the attacking model is within 12" of the bearer's unit (range condition not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Comrades in Wrath
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Upgrade for a Gilded Blades Allarus Custodians unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Shattering Charge
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: When the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit engaged with it: that unit makes a Battle-shock roll with -1 to the roll.
